notes.title: [SKYBOX VR] Steam v1.1.8 Release
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We just released SKYBOX Steam version 1.1.8. 

What is new in v1.1.8:
- Supported WebDAV
- Supported adjusting image display time
- Added Ultra Cinema environment
- Fixed some known issues

About WebDAV, you can access WebDAV with Basic Authentication. Currently SKYBOX supports accessing Alist, Nutstore, Yandex and PikPak server. To connect to the WebDAV server, please: 
1. Go to SKYBOX's Network channel
2. Click the Add icon on the top left corner > select Add WebDAV server
3. Input your WebDAV server's IP address or domain name preceded by "http://" or "https://"
4. Enter your login credentials

What's more, you can set the image display time to your preference in Global Settings. 

Note: 
1. If you can't open the app, please open the Oculus software on your PC, navigate to Settings -> General, and set Meta Quest Link as active OpenXR runtime.
2. If you can't use controllers in SKYBOX, please unplug other game controllers connected to your PC and see if it helps.

Hope you like the update! If you experience any problems, please reach out to contact@skybox.xyz or send us in-app feedback. 

Cheers,
SKYBOX STUDIO

notes.title: [SKYBOX VR] Steam v1.1.4: Supported Image Format, Fisheye190°, and more
notes.content:
Hey friends,

We released a new version 1.1.4 in the Steam store. This version included new features, bug fixes and enhancements.

What’s new in Steam v1.1.4:
- Supported image format
- Supported Fisheye 190° videos
- Turn on/off network viewing history
- Optimized UI animation
- Optimized dynamic lighting
 
To use the version, you need to:
1. Right-click the “SKYBOX VR Video Player” in your Steam library and select “Properties”. (If you can't find SKYBOX in library, please search for it in the search bar)
2. Click the “BETAS” tab, and select the “beta - beta branch” from the dropdown list to switch to the beta channel. Then, you will see "SKYBOX VR Video Player [beta]" in your library list.
3. Download the update and start the beta version.
 
We’ll continue to optimize this version. If you encounter any issues, don’t hesitate to send us(contact@skybox.xyz) a bug report. You can also click SKYBOX’s Global Settings and click the BUG icon in the upper-right corner to submit feedback. Ticking the "upload logs" box will help identify the problems faster. 

Cheers,
SKYBOX STUDIO

notes.title: New Update: Steam v1.1.2 Release
notes.content:
Hey all!

SKYBOX Steam v1.1.2 is now available.  We added some new features to keep it consistent with the latest Quest version. 

What's new in Steam v1.1.2:
- [Feature] Added HDR support
- [Feature] Supported 200-degree field of view
- [Optimization] Improved video format recognition accuracy
- [Optimization] Improved file loading speed 
- [Feature] Added support for custom thumbnails
- [Feature] Added volume booster in advanced settings (you can increase volume above 100%)
- [Feature] Displayed the stylings (e.g. fonts, colors, etc) and animated effects of subtitles
- [Feature] Supported subtitles for VR 180/360 videos (when you turn your head, the subtitle moves with you)
- [Feature] Added buffer indicator in network videos
- [Bug Fixes] Fixed some known issues

We're constantly working to improve app stability and refine some features. If you need help, please click [b]Global Settings[/b] and click the [b]BUG icon[/b] in the upper-right corner to [b]send us a bug report[/b]. Ticking the "upload logs" box will help identify the problems faster. You can also report found issues to [b]contact@skybox.xyz[/b].

notes.title: SKYBOX v1.0.1 Release Log
notes.content:
Hi friends,

We've been received feedback reporting that there is no loading screen nor UI display when launching SKYBOX. However, we were never able to reproduce the issue on our side. 

In the past month, we've been testing on different PCs with various specs and Windows version. We put together our findings and present you with the fix version of v1.0.1.

Here are the main changes of v1.0.1:
[Fixed Bug] Trying to fix the fail-to-loading issue. 
[Fixed Bug] Fixed certain fisheye videos cannot be displayed.
[Fixed Bug] Fixed certain subtitle cannot be turned off.
[Optimization] Support Valve Index controller. 
[Optimization] Support Oculus Quest 1 & 2 controller. 

If you still encounter issues when trying to launch SKYBOX, especially error 101 and error 102, please reach us at support@skybox.xyz so we could provide further help for you.

Thank you for your support and we wish you a happy new year.

Cheers,
SKYBOX STUDIO

notes.title: SKYBOX v0.2.0 Release Log
notes.content:
Hi there,

First thank you very much for all you support!
Sorry for keep you waiting so long but we released the v0.2.0 in January and it comes with tons of new features.

Here is a list of new features:
[Feature] Support deleting video files within SKYBOX.
[Feature] View by List.
[Feature] Shortcuts to frequently-used folders (Pin Folder).
[Feature] Sorting by Name/Size/Time.
[Feature] Manually adapt to Youtube 360 (EAC).
[Feature] Support Youtube 180 (Fisheye) videos.
[Feature] Display full filename when cursor hovers over a video.
[Feature] Double click the controller button to pause and resume playback.
[Feature] New cinema scene "Moon".
[Feature] Lighting adjustment in Movie Theatre Scene.
[Feature] Seat change in Movie Theatre Scene.
[Feature] SMB support.
[Feature] Auto play next video on the playlist.
[Feature] Adjustment for eye distance (offset) for 3D videos.
[Feature] Support filling in SMB username/password using keyboard.
[Optimization] Upgrade player engine for improved playback performance and compatibility.
[Optimization] Optimize format recognition engine to improve recognition accuracy.
[Fixed Bug] Audio issue and reen screen issue occurred when playing certain videos.

If you encounter any issues, please drop us an email at support@skybox.xyz.
Also, here is the official SKYBOX forum where you can post any comments/feedback/bug reports: https://forum.skybox.xyz

Hope you enjoy the new version :)

Cheers,
SKYBOX STUDIO
